cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put the director's confident 'business as usual' on the launch programme. Keep her name above the department heads.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was her automatic email reply. She's resigned; the notice is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, a continuity message. Put the notice in my drawer; the heads will each claim the launch if they see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're already asking who gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give each head the same short introduction; none of them takes her slot.

reason: Copy an automated assurance as actual confidence and conceal resignation to prevent competing heads inheriting control.
